criteria.criterion: Complete connected content, not a glossary
criteria.requirement: Choose one already owned complete unit, preserve every raw group/reader, give each group a concrete semantic or grammatical contribution or an explicit barrier. A barrier does not reset scope. Beginning with partial hypotheses is allowed; a useful near-full reading must account for the controls between its propositions.

Use the directed existing hierarchy where applicable; give repeated exact forms the same value/rule. Charge each new part value, whole residual, context wrapper, reader alternative, default and scope exception. Do not manufacture productivity by deleting internal o or q/ch; do not treat 98 units as an alphabet. Cost is descriptive, not likelihood.

Show which written expressions select subjects, objects, classes, comparison baselines and reference scope. Unconfirmed names and paid defaults may begin C0, but a donated ambient output or source-ID wire must be exposed as an assumption rather than a recovered argument grammar. No obligatory invented event/output/consumer is imposed on declarative content.

Derive at least one consequence of combining propositions that cannot be removed by simply changing a noun in the English rendering: shared identity, opposed comparison direction, persistent constituent, exclusion or a genuinely changed dependency. Compare a concrete rival fairly. If a jointly renamed graph preserves everything, retain the semantic ambiguity; coherent C0 is still a valid outcome.

criteria.criterion: Known adverse cases first, fixed falsifier next
criteria.requirement: Keep saved frequencies, repeats, isolated labels, native uncertainty and prior contradictions visible. Freeze the achieved rules before their next complete-unit application. No confirmed anchor or independent discriminator is required to begin authorship. Reserved confirmation remains a later phase requiring adequate whole-unit predictions and unchanged rules.

route.name: Joint same-owner optical comparison; whole authorship, not another nominal-light audit
unit: complete f89v1.13-20 ZL/IT paragraph and RF corresponding window
route.first_duty: Author both complete inscriptions with one finite light-source/recipient/appearance grammar, provisionally treating the pictured phases as one Moon referent rather than inheriting ok=MOON and oko=SUN. Preserve the two-body Sun/Moon rival and lower owner uncertainty. Then complete the entire owned f89 unit under the same word values and reference rules.
semantic_kernel: one light source S and persistent lunar body M
illumination of an exposed portion of M distinct from M itself and from Earth-facing appearance A(M)
greater source-M separation entails increasing Earth-facing light; approach entails decreasing it, under the source ordinary-course condition
the changing state does not create a new celestial body or change its identity
route.minimal_form_duty: Choose a finite existing composite family and declare a genuinely common operation only where its actual saved decomposition licenses it. aN is a candidate for an appearance/state projection, not a compelled choice. ok+o+aN requires its internal-o/whole residual; okor/okar must retain reader-specific productions. q/ch may be contextual packaging rather than semantic operators. No operation has a confirmed meaning.
no_source_donation: no unexpressed Sun or Earth introduced merely because Morgan names them
no invented scalar input table keyed by source IDs
no deletion of unknown intervening groups
no automatic eclipse at opposition or full phase
no modern illuminated-fraction formula attributed to the historical source
route.genuine_change_from_predecessors: W/BB/Y supplied sparse interval/light products or a binary LIGHTS relation, and BI supplied no new comparative target assignments. This duty must derive two opposed comparison consequences from a shared written argument/referral grammar across complete contexts; the same sparse slots renamed remain unchanged work.
route.later_literal_falsifier: After a complete model is frozen, reject that exact model if the same licensed comparison with the same selected S/M and unchanged scope yields greater separation plus decreased Earth-facing illumination, or approach plus increased illumination, without an independently written exception licensed before freeze; also reject its identity rule if a reused M-expression must denote a different body to finish the same passage.
route.later_form_falsifier: Reject the exact finite construction if a retained same-scope repeat/alternate requires incompatible input arity or sort, requires deleting q/ch/internal o, or supplies no written argument under its obligatory policy. An unresolved control instead leaves the claimed chain conditional/incomplete, not a contradiction of the astronomical domain.
route.future_scope: First use retained complete contexts as development crosschecks, not fresh blindness. A later unseen complete-unit application must be selected and registered without inspecting its relevant content, and include the full argument/conditional chain. No specific new locus or reserve is requested now.
may_fail: rings do not encode paired phases or relational comparison
lower owner is Sun, full Moon or another iconographic referent; same-Moon assumption may be wrong
no written source/separation/scalar polarity in the finite grammar
same forms require unsupported reader or scope exceptions
whole f89 continuation does not preserve the optical referents
light, duration or a renamed material relation still has identical written consequences
route.gain_if_coherent: A near-full, finite connected optical reading with retained countercases and predictions suitable for later selection; meaningful limits on lexical freedom, not a confirmed lexeme.
route.gain_if_fails: Reject the specific paid construction or locate its actual written argument/arity/scope obstruction; do not conclude all light content impossible or restart a census.
route.meaning_ceiling: Even two opposite authored consequences may be preserved by a joint relabeling of quantities and roles. The source law alone selects no target meaning. Native crescent ownership can add celestial plausibility, but the lower owner and word-level binding remain uncertain.

novelty: Changed whole comparative authorship design, not new source causal law or reopened successful test
